items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Define W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Define ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. Write A_n(h,s) for the complete history obtained by preserving every old coordinate h_j and appending live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and appending stopped when h_n=stopped. Put L_n(h,s)=(A_n(h,s),s). Negative real times use the displayed raw-real harmonic flow with a clipped cumulative increment; this and the stopped branch are auxiliary totalizations, with actual positive finite jump identification only on the guard below. H_(n+1), A_n and L_n are Borel, and A_n(h,s)_j=h_j for every old index0≤j≤n and every abstract(h,s). For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each value finite but with no uniform bound, define D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s), B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), Y_n(w)=(H_(n+1)(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)) and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗real Lebesgue). B_d and Y_n are Borel. For every w∈B_d, H_(n+1)(w)=A_n(X_n(w)), preserving the actual old records and appending exactly the actual cumulative next time and post-bounce state. The actual restricted laws satisfy (Y_n)_*(P|B_d)=(L_n)_*ν_d and (H_(n+1))_*(P|B_d)=(A_n)_*ν_d, and ((L_n)_*ν_d)(Hist_(n+1)×ℝ)≤1. These are restricted finite-component laws; no unrestricted next-history law is asserted. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the function h↦∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness/integrability hypothesis on F, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, constructor-law or measurability provider is assumed. The cases n=0, d=0, null A, stopped/infinite waits, zero hazard/normal, rank zero and unrealizable histories are included; infinite waits and zero/cutoff endpoints fail the strict guard, without an atom-equivalence assertion. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one actual complete-history extension ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), using the already verified conditional finite-density law. Ordered absolute-time iteration, final survival/path-factor assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual restart/Markovness, global conclusions, implementation/error/unbounded cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. Survival88 and a separate no-atom theorem are not proof prerequisites.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, including rank zero; V:E→ℝ is C².
The six original analytic hypotheses are α>0, α≤β, V∈C², α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v, η>0 and βη≤1, with α,β≥0.
y,r,z₀ and deterministic depth n are universally quantified. The actual stopped recursion and raw iid Exp1 product P are literal definitions.

d:Hist_n→NNReal is any fixed Borel finite-valued cutoff, possibly unbounded across histories; F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→ENNReal is any jointly Borel test, and A is any Borel old-history event, including null events.
Every history/append/lift measurability fact, actual guarded constructor identity and transported law is a conclusion, not an input premise. The strict finite guard is never normalized.

formulae.label: Actual complete-history extension 3
formulae.tex: w\in B_d\ \Longrightarrow\ H_{n+1}(w)=A_n(H_n(w),t_n(w)),\quad A_n(h,s)_j=h_j\ (0\le j\le n).
